# costgraph_google_cloud_integration (Resource)

Connect an existing Google Cloud billing export through service account impersonation. Requires an organization owner's user API key with the organization:manage scope. CostGraph verifies real export access before saving settings. Service account, federation, and BigQuery export setup remain outside this resource. Updates preserve the connection UUID. Import uses its UUID and supports impersonation connections only. Destroying the resource disconnects collection and removes the account's billing data from cost views.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "costgraph_google_cloud_integration" "production" {
  tenant_id          = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  billing_account_id = "012345-ABCDEF-6789AB"
  display_name       = "Production Google Cloud"
  query_project      = "billing-export-project"
  target_principal   = "costgraph-reader@billing-export-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `billing_account_id` (String) Billing account whose export CostGraph reads. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `query_project` (String) Existing Google Cloud project where CostGraph queries the BigQuery billing export.
- `target_principal` (String) Service account principal CostGraph impersonates to read the billing export. Configure impersonation and BigQuery access before creating the connection. Service-account JSON keys are not supported by this resource.
- `tenant_id` (String) Lowercase UUID of the tenant that receives the billing data. Changing it replaces the connection.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in CostGraph. Defaults to the billing account identifier. Omitting it after creation preserves the existing name.
- `enable_recommendations` (Boolean) Allow CostGraph to collect the provider's savings recommendations. Defaults to true. The cloud identity needs the corresponding read permissions.

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) Public connection identifier. Use id for import.
- `id` (String) Connection UUID used for management and import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import costgraph_google_cloud_integration.production 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002
```
